en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a wooden railway station building with a gabled central section and two lower wings. A sign on the upper façade reads "BODAFORS" and there is a clock above the main entrance. Multiple railway tracks run across the foreground, with overhead power lines above. Trees frame the station on both sides. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border and a small number is printed in the lower right corner.
